children.title: Cycle 57 · Exploring Cognitive Humor Theories: Incongruity and Benign Violation

detail.title: Exploring Cognitive Humor Theories: Incongruity and Benign Violation
detail.summary: This cycle initiates research into the cognitive mechanisms of humor, specifically focusing on incongruity-resolution and benign violation theory as primary frameworks. We are proceeding with the active comedy project to establish a grounded, source-backed baseline for understanding why humans find certain stimuli humorous, while strictly adhering to the current enforcement rotation.

children.title: incongruity-resolution theory humor benign violation theory mcgraw review

detail.reason: To identify foundational literature defining the mechanisms of incongruity-resolution and benign violation theory, allowing for a comparative analysis of how each framework explains humor response.
